content: Yesus no Youyou Langa Yafou Waha Nomo Fati Anyakaro nerigon bona manai.
Ariya, iinga saini ila langa, Yesus no Galili distrik huwanya langanga golowai. No ege Judia distrik langa, goidu golowei nomo awai, taate bona, Juda nere no dukote wodbode ono wane.
Ono gainga, Juda nebere bori nomo fati aroro nere heigode jugu wane. Fati Aroro wa, Youyou Mata Langa Yafei Nomo Fati.
Onou bona, nomo bemu gane benou letuwane, “Ne matane beha awadu Judia goyau, ono wahenga, name disaipel nere ne haruwe hogo fere-fere te-teni waha urodbode.
Onou wa, fai ete no, fai isi tuwode wonga, no haruwe haumu huwari la ada ono-onona. Ne dada onouha onowau ganga wonga, ne malala otodu fai-aita oruwanga agenege langa onowau.”
Nomo bemu gane fere, nere no bode huwanyanege ngalengawei uwa, waha bona, nere onou letuwane.
Ono wanenga, Yesus no beele ege gidu lenigai, “Ji yame saini iinga heigei uwa inyina. Ariya, saini oruwa wa, tebere saini.
Nere fai-aita oulaha tere honggoro langa ada tafa tigodbode. Nere ji honggoro hiyodbode, taate bona, ji nere nebere fanyinege inyaba, waha boni beele malalamudu le‑leni.
Onou waha bona, tere bori nomo fati aroro waha langa Jerusalem managu. Ji walanga ada manoni, taate bona, ji yame saini iinga heigei uwa inyina.”
No onou lenigidu bona, no Galili walanga itaridu yafai.
Ariya, saini nomo bemu gane mani hara ganenga, Yesus no fere, iinga huunta manai. Ariya, no fai adai uroguga bona no huwari manidu golowai.
Ono gainga, Juda nebere fai aroro nere, bori nomo fati aroro waha langa no kuru tunga wane, ono bode lewane, “Fai waha alanga yafana?”
Ono gane, nere fai-aita no bode beele baingaro, nere nage gamanege langa leguruwane. Nere ila lewane, “No fai hilobainga.” Ono ganenga, nere ila lewane, “Uwa, no fai-aita yaawa nigi-nigina.”
Ono bode, nere Juda nebere fai araro umuge nigi bode, fai ete no nomo onowou bona beele malala lewei uwa.
Ariya, fati aroro waha nomo fati gamala, Yesus no tempel nomo orei huwanya la goidu bona, nere fai-aita isisiwou nigai.
Ono wainga, nere Juda nomo beele waha isidu bode ninanege baingaro isi bode lewane, “Adadu bona fai beha no isou benouha bagu? No skul langa goyei uwa.”
Ono wanenga, Yesus no nere ege gidu benou lenigai, “Beele ji tere letigini beha, yame beele uwa. Wa Itou nomo beele, no ji huuru hiyainga meene.

Onou waha bona, fai ete no Itou nomo beele oojowei nomo tigini gau tuwei mata wonga wa, no beele ji leni beha nomo hugu tigini isi dewonbona. Onodu bona, no isona bona, beele beha, Itou langa maina yo, uwa, ji yage yame ninafe langa heigena.

Ariya, fai no nogo nomo ninau langa beele lena wa, no nogo nomo unyi jaimu wona onona. Ariya fai no, fai huuru tuwainga mai waha nomo unyi isouwei nomo gau tuna waha, fai no waha fai tigini. No yaawawou fai uwau.
“Amina, Moses no nuuni beele tigaiha. Ariya, tere gamatege langa, fai ete no nuuni beele waha ada oojo-oojona. Onou waha bona, tere taate boya ji duufe kote wagu ganga onoya?”
Ono wainga, fai-aita nere ege gidu benou letuwane, “Hauri inyaba ete ne langa inyina rute. Faiwei ne dute kote wonga umau ganga leni?”
Ono wanenga, Yesus no ege gidu lenigai, “Ji haruwe etenga ono wenenga, tere oruwa ninatege baingaro isei.

Onou wa isagu Moses no genege gala karu nagei nomo fanyimu waha tigaiha, ariya tere bori nomo fati langa fere, magana mene-mene genege gala karu nagi-nagiya. Ngalenga, Moses no nogo fanyimu waha heigemuwei uwa. Tere tebere asatege gane langa heigai.

Ariya, tere Moses nomo beele oojo dewagu ganga bori nomo fati langa magana genege gala karu nagi-nagia. Ariya ji bori nomo fati langa fai ete gogala jigemu tu dewehenga, tere taate boya ji bonade houtege mayonbona?
Tere agetege magana ewe langa, dada adai haawe wagu. Tere dada oruwanga, onowou ngalenga wahanga la haawe wagu.”
Nere fai-aita bagu Yesus no faiwei tigini waha isodbode ono wane.
Ariya, nere Jerusalemha fai-aita ila, dada Yesus onowainga uredu bode lewane, “Adadu? Fai no behanga, nere fai araro no dukotewei nomo bode ono-onode.
Ariya uragu. No beele malala gamala lena, nere no beele ete letuwegu uwa. Nere iside rute, fai no beha Itou no fai-aita bagu gidu hanigei nomo beele baara tawai waha huuru tuwainga maai?
Ariya, ere fai beha nomo matane hugu ere isiya. Onou wa, saini fai Itou no huuru tuwonga monbona, beele baara tawai waha heigona la, fai ete no nomo matane hugu bona ada isona.”

Ariya, Yesus no tempel langa yafa bona, nere fai-aita beele malalamudu lenigai. Onodu no yauredu benou lewai, “Tere ji boya isiya, ji yame matane hugu boya isiyawou leya yo? Onou wa ji yage yame gauwou langa meei uwa. Jijei no ji huuru hiyainga meene. No nomo onouwou wa tigini. Ariya tere no boya ada isiya.
Ji no boni isini. Ji no ngare yafere, onodu no ji huuru hiyainga meene.”
Ono wainga nere beele waha isidu bode, no dagou mata langa tafa tuwodbode ono wane. Ariya, no nomo saini iinga heigei uwa inyina, onou waha bona, fai ete no langa owo tafei uwa.

Ariya, nere fai-aita baingaro no bode huwanyanege ngalenga wainga nere lewane, “Saini Itou no fai waha huuru tuwonbona beele baara tawai waha heigona la, no dodokawou baingaro fai beha onona waha feiya tuwou ono wona rute?”
Nere Yesus dagou mata langa tafa tuwei nomo bode polis huuru nigane.

Ariya, Yesus no dada onowai waha fai nere uredu bode, beele hogo fere-fere lewanenga Farisi nere isane. Onodu bode, nere Pris araro bagu, nere Farisi bagu, Yesus yaasu tuwei nomo bode, polis huuru niganenga mayane.
Ono wanenga, Yesus no lewai, “Ji tere bagu saini tutu mene yafon boni, onodu ji Jijei bagu ege gidu manon boni, no ji huuru hiyainga meene.
Ono wehenga, tere ji kuru hiyagu wa, tere ji ada yeriyagu ganga. Haumu ji yafoni waha langa, tere manei nomo edo uwa.”
Ono wainga, Juda nere nage-nage benou leguru wane, “No alanga goyonga, ere no ada uroboya lena? No ebere gane nebere kantri Grik langa yafade la goidu bona isisiwou nigona rute?
No benou lewaha, ‘Tere ji kuru hiyagu wa, tere ji ada yeriyagu ganga.’ Ha ji yafoni waha langa, tere mayei nomo edo uwa. Waha nomo hugu adadu?”
Yesus no agenege auma nomo yaage bona lewai.

Bori anyakaro waha nebere fati usuwou wa nere fati gai anyakaro tigini. Ariya fati waha langa, Yesus no oto bona yauredu lewai, “Fai ete no yaage nyomoli tuwonga wa, no edo ji bagu maidu bona yaage nyona.
Wa Itou nomo buk langa inyina dorofe. Fai no ji bona huwanya ngalengana wa, no yaage agenege auma nomo baingaro huwanya langa heigedu guriyena dorofe.”

Ariya, Yesus no Hauri Guuni bona lewai. Nere fai no bode huwanyanege ngalengade waha, nere Hauri Guuni todbode. Saini beha langa, Yesus no unyi anyakaro tei uwa inyina, waha bona Hauri Guuni no mei uwa inyina.
Nere fai-aita foure nga wane.
Ariya, nere fai-aita ila Yesus nomo beele isidu bode lewane, “Ngalenga tigini, fai beha no profet, Itou no amina huuru tuwonga oula langa mei nomo bona lewai waha.”
Ono wanenga, nere ila lewane, “No fai, Itou no nomo fai-aita ege gidu hanigei nomo hangada tuwai waha.” Ono ganenga, nere ila lewane, “Uwa. Fai Itou hangada tuwai waha no Galili langa ada heigona.
Itou nomo buk no benou lena, fai waha no King Devit nomo ganemu la heigonbona. Onou waha bona, no Betlehem taon amina Devit yafai waha langa heigonbona.”
Onodu, fai-aita nere Yesus bode isou fere-fere tedu nere foure nga wane.
Onodu nere ila no dagou mata langa tafa tuwei nomo ono wane, ariya fai ete no langa owo tafei uwa.
Mora bagu nere Yesus bode huwanyanege ngalengawei uwa.
Ariya, polis nere ege gidu bode, pris aroro bagu Farisi bagu langa goyane. Ono wanenga, nere isoki nigane, “Ada wanga tere no haudu mayegu uwa?”
Ono wanenga, polis nere ege gidu benou lenigane, “Fai ete amina, fai beha beele lena dorofe, ete lewei uwa.”
Onou leniganenga, nere Farisi ege gidu benou lenigane, “Tere fere no yaawa tigaha rute?
Tere ere mora bagu, nere Farisi bagu, ebereha ete no bona huwanya ngalenga wanga ureyaha yo? Gai uwanga uwa.
Ariya, nere no bode huwanyanege ngalengana waha, wa nere fai-aita bagu nuuni beele ada iside waha. Itou no nere yaewei nomo leboro waiha.”
Nikodemus no amina Yesus bagu goyaiha, no waha nebereha ete. Onou bona, no benou lenigai,
“Ere ebere nuuni beele no ere fai ete ewe auma kot langa tafa tuwei nomo lena yo? Uwa. Ngasunga ere no nomo beele aagudu boya, ere no taate dada onowai waha boya isi dewoboya.”

Ono wainga, nere nomo beele waha ege gidu benou letuwane, “Ne fere, ne Galiliha fai rute? Itou nomo buk langa beele inyina waha lelege dewau, onodu ne fere isau ganga, profet ete Galili walanga ada heigonbona.”
Nere aita une tafai waha haudu, Yesus bagu tamayane.
